test_title: PYST 52: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Kiran can do a certain piece of work in 26 days. Kiran and Garima can together do the same work in 13 days, and Kiran, Garima and Mehak can do the same work together in 10 days. In how many days can Kiran and Mehak do the same work together?
solution:
**Given:**

Kiran can do the work in 26 days

Kiran and Garima together can do the work in 13 days

Kiran, Garima and Mehak together can do the work in 10 days

**Formula Used:**

Work done per day = 1 ÷ Number of days

Time = 1 ÷ Combined work per day

**Calculation:**

⇒ Kiran’s 1 day work = 1 ÷ 26

⇒ (Kiran + Garima)’s 1 day work = 1 ÷ 13

⇒ Garima’s 1 day work = (1 ÷ 13) − (1 ÷ 26)

⇒ Garima’s 1 day work = 1 ÷ 26

⇒ (Kiran + Garima + Mehak)’s 1 day work = 1 ÷ 10

⇒ Mehak’s 1 day work = (1 ÷ 10) − (1 ÷ 13)

⇒ Mehak’s 1 day work = 3 ÷ 130

⇒ (Kiran + Mehak)’s 1 day work = (1 ÷ 26) + (3 ÷ 130)

⇒ (Kiran + Mehak)’s 1 day work = (5 + 3) ÷ 130

⇒ (Kiran + Mehak)’s 1 day work = 8 ÷ 130

⇒ (Kiran + Mehak)’s 1 day work = 4 ÷ 65

⇒ Required time = 65 ÷ 4

**∴ The correct answer is 64/4.**
